cases.classReason: One agent can read the whole task and check its own arithmetic, so nothing is gained by splitting it.
cases.input: Compute 17 multiplied by 23. Reply with the number only.

controls.reason: A collaboration adds handoffs and coordination tokens to a task one Agent completes alone, so the collaboration profile should lose to a simpler profile: no gain in success for more cost.

cases.classReason: Each sample can produce a complete answer on its own and their errors are independent, so aggregating samples, not communication, is what can help.
cases.input: Name the smallest prime number greater than 90. Reply with the number only.

cases.classReason: The evidence splits into disjoint shards that workers can search independently and one reducer must combine.
cases.input: Three ledger shards each record one digit of a vault code, in shard order A, B, C. Report the three-digit code with no separators.

controls.reason: Each participant sees one shard, so every independent sample lacks two of the three digits and a majority vote over their answers cannot recover evidence no single participant saw.

cases.classReason: Each step consumes the previous step's result, so no stage can start before its input artifact exists.
cases.input: Convert 5 miles to kilometres (1 mile is 1.609344 kilometres), round the result to the nearest whole number, then double it. Reply with the final number only.

cases.classReason: Two writers update one authoritative count, so ordering, freshness, and a single commit authority decide whether the result is correct.
cases.input: An inventory count starts at 10. One clerk records a delivery of 5 units and another records a shipment of 3 units. Report the final count.

cases.classReason: Several writers change one count, so the count needs one owner, a freshness rule, and one commit authority.
cases.input: An inventory count starts at 20. Three clerks each record a shipment of 4 units on a shared scratchpad. Report the final count.

controls.reason: Participants that only write to an undeclared scratchpad have not coordinated: those writes are reported as ungoverned writes and never count as coordination turns, tokens, or commits.

cases.classReason: A verifier can count words cheaply and return a structured defect the producer revises against, within a bounded number of rounds.
cases.input: Write one sentence about rivers that has exactly seven words.

successContract.name: exact-word-count
successContract.description: The response is one sentence whose whitespace-separated word count equals the expected number.
